notes: temp-code is ready to distribute: the repo is public at github.com/LandonDev/temp-code (every blob in the history was scanned for tokens, keys, OAuth blobs and Keychain dumps first and came up clean; .gitignore now covers .temp-code/, artifacts/, src/main/server/media/ and release/), the Mac build is signed and notarized (electron-builder.yml: hardened runtime, the Developer ID Application identity from the login Keychain, notarization through the aliax notarytool profile, arm64 zip + dmg only, the Appshots Swift helper under mac.binaries so it carries the same signature, scripts/app-mcp-bridge.mjs still ships, asar off and the runAsNode fuse off as before, publish = this repo's GitHub releases), and the installed app updates itself through electron-updater's GitHub provider instead of rebuilding the source checkout with bun: src/main/update.ts checks the feed at launch, every 30 minutes and on focus after 15 idle minutes, downloads only when asked, restarts on request and turns the feed's HTML notes into text; the renderer keeps one update status for the sidebar footer, Settings → General and the menu (idle/checking/current/available/downloading/ready/error, a real download percent, "Restart to update"). Versioning: package.json carries 1.0.N beside release.json's N (1.0.198 today), scripts/release.ts bumps both and tags release-N on every green commit as before, and the new `bun run release:publish` (scripts/release-publish.sh, the shape of Aliax's release) signs, notarizes, uploads the zip, dmg, blockmap and latest-mac.yml to the GitHub release v1.0.N, writes the notes from the commits since the last v1.0.* tag, verifies the feed and pushes the tag; CLAUDE.md and README describe the split and the arm64-only scope. Aliax is built in: an Accounts section under Chats, in the classic sidebar (WorkspaceSessions) and the deck rail alike, opens Aliax's own Accounts and Stats pages (src/renderer/src/aliax: 37 files copied from Aliax with their shadcn, reui and evilcharts components; aliax.css compiles their utilities in a separate Tailwind pass wrapped in @scope (.aliax-root), the four color families that clash with ours renamed ax-*, dark: scoped to the pages, portals carry the class; AliaxPagesView.tsx is the header strip, shell.ts holds accountsPage) over window.aliax (src/preload/aliax.ts), whose main-process side (src/main/aliaxPages.ts, src/main/aliax/{login,claude-web-login,stats}) is Aliax's ipc.ts, sign-in flows and stats store, indexer and queries ported verbatim against aliax-core: capture, activate (proven before it is reported), delete, nickname and color, the sign-in windows, the stats bundle. Usage never gets a second poller: the pages read the server's accounts snapshot, a manual refresh goes through accountsStore.refresh, services are re-listed only when an identity moves, and every snapshot's windows plus the core's own samples land in a stats.db under temp-code's userData, seeded once by copying Aliax's so months of pace history and the indexed logs carry over. Verified in a dev instance over CDP with Aliax running: both layouts show the section, the panels render 35 usage bars from the shared poll, one services:list per open, zero bridge calls over 15 s idle, the row menu's portal is themed, Stats shows its totals and charts, and leaving restores the board. Tests: updater, updateStore, updaterConfig, apptools (the bridge ships), sidebarRows, aliax/pages.dom.
